newsitem.title: USA: Avis CEO Joseph Vittoria to retire.
newsitem.headline: Avis CEO Joseph Vittoria to retire.

text.p: HFS Inc said Monday Joseph V. Vittoria, chairman and chief executive officer of its Avis Inc subsidiary, will retire effective February 1.
HFS said Vittoria was stepping down after helping manage the transition from an employee-owned company to a subsidiary of HFS, which he had agreed to do when HFS bought the company in October 1996.
HFS said it planned an initial public offering of the rental car operating subsidiary in 1997.

HFS Vice Chairman Stephen Holmes will become interim chief executive officer while the company conducts a search through the New York office of Heidrick & Struggles for Vittoria's replacement, it said.
